# Athreya M R

Front-end Architect in Bangalore. Live site: https://athreya.codes

## Summary

Athreya M R has been building Angular products since 2015. He works at Mimecast as a Senior Software Engineer on a next-generation email security platform — Angular, micro frontends, and an Nx monorepo.

Before Mimecast he was a Product Engineer at Enate Technologies Ltd (2019–2024), leading a front-end team on a micro-frontend product. Before that he was a Software Engineer at Mphasis Ltd (2015–2019), building Angular applications for FedEx.

Skills: Angular, TypeScript, micro frontends, Module Federation, Nx monorepos, SSR/SSG, technical SEO, web performance, accessibility, and design systems. He is also exploring AI-enabled fullstack delivery.

## This site

https://athreya.codes is an Angular 22 SSR/SSG portfolio. Routes are prerendered so search engines and social crawlers receive real titles, descriptions, and content — not an empty client shell.

## Work history

- 2024–present — Senior Software Engineer, Mimecast — next-gen email security platform, Angular, micro frontends, Nx monorepo
- 2019–2024 — Product Engineer, Enate Technologies Ltd — led a front-end team on a micro-frontend product
- 2015–2019 — Software Engineer, Mphasis Ltd — Angular web development for FedEx
